long_biography.plain_text:
Construction contracts in Saudi Arabia gave Al Amoudi the capital base for a wider international portfolio. Collaboration with Swedish engineers led him toward Europe, where he acquired OK Petroleum in 1994 and developed it as Preem. In Ethiopia, he returned as an investor through MIDROC, first emphasizing gold mining before broadening into cement, agriculture, manufacturing, hotels and services.

Al Amoudi organized those businesses around local managers and long-term reinvestment. He also directed philanthropy toward education, technical training and healthcare, treating skills development as part of the investment model. The 2026 sale of Preem shifted his focus back toward Saudi Arabia and Ethiopia, with European assets moving toward professional family-office stewardship for the next generation.
